summary: Distinct authority mining found that the documented canonical Studio lab placement is not source-enforced: PhysicsLabStudioHarness.start accepts any Instance parent, forwards it to PhysicsLabRealizer.realize, and the realizer commits UNRENDERED_PhysicsLab beneath that parent without requiring Workspace or an approved project-owned Workspace container. Draft docs-only PR #499 records the exact source repro and recommends a bounded placement-policy regression before any repair. This is separate from the retained wrong-context bootstrap, Rojo deployment, teardown, and raw-destroy capability lineages. No Studio/two-client evidence is claimed.
evidence: Inspected main af6a17aa7969d40e8b19f7e9d19fe93cc9b1d9a9. Docs/PHYSICS_LAB.md says the Studio representation is realized into Workspace/UNRENDERED_PhysicsLab.
src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabStudioHarness.luau exposes start(parent: Instance?) and calls PhysicsLabRealizer.realize(parent or workspace) after only Studio/server context checks.

src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabRealizer.luau accepts realize(parent: Instance), checks collisions only beneath the supplied parent, and commits model.Parent = parent with no Workspace-placement predicate.
Source repro: a Studio server caller can supply ReplicatedStorage (or another non-Workspace Instance) as the parent; no current boundary rejects that request before physical realization.

Open authority lineages found during the audit cover wrong-context bootstrap ordering (#348/#394), Rojo source placement (#300 lineage), teardown/lifecycle ownership, and raw RealizedLab.destroy capability (#399 lineage); searches did not surface a dedicated parent-placement repair/regression.
Draft PR #499 exact head 13a696da70ff605b4d7ab3ae392f0a103f4a0200 is one docs-only commit ahead of main and changes exactly Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_PARENT_AUTHORITY_FINDING.md (+68/-0).

metadata.recommendedNext: When a bounded authority leaf is explicitly scheduled, define the v1 approved Workspace placement policy, add an expected-red non-Workspace-parent regression, then fail closed before any physical lab model is committed outside that placement.
